NOS-DOS Quick Start
===================

5 MINUTES TO A WORKING DOS ENVIRONMENT
---------------------------------------

STEP 1: BOOT
  Import the NOS-DOS OVA into VirtualBox (or use the VMX/QEMU image).
  Power on. The system boots in under 10 seconds and lands in NOS-SHELL.

STEP 2: NAVIGATE NOS-SHELL
  Arrow keys   Move cursor in file panel
  Tab          Switch between left and right panel
  Enter        Open directory or run file
  F1           Help (this documentation)
  F3           View file
  F5           Copy file
  F6           Move/rename file
  F7           Create directory
  F8           Delete file
  F9           Application launcher
  F10          Quit to DOS prompt
  F12          Drop to DOS shell (type EXIT to return)
  Ctrl+R       Refresh panels

STEP 3: CONNECT TO THE INTERNET
  Press F12 to open a DOS prompt, then:
    NNET DHCP          Obtain an IP address
    NNET STATUS        Verify connection
    NNET PING 8.8.8.8  Test connectivity
    EXIT               Return to NOS-SHELL

STEP 4: INSTALL AN APPLICATION
    NPKG UPDATE            Download package index
    NPKG SEARCH word       Find word processors
    NPKG INSTALL GALAXY    Install Galaxy Write
    NPKG LIST              See installed packages
  The application appears in the F9 launcher automatically.

STEP 5: EXCHANGE FILES WITH YOUR HOST
    NBRIDGE MOUNT          Mount shared folder on H:\
    NBRIDGE DIRS           Create INBOX/OUTBOX/PRINT/CLIP
  Copy files to H:\OUTBOX\ and they appear on your host desktop
  (run watch_outbox.py from the host_helpers/ folder on the host).

STEP 6: PLAY A GAME
    NPKG INSTALL DOOM      Install DOOM Shareware
    NOSPLAY DOOM           Launch with correct speed/sound profile
  Or press F9 and select the game from the launcher.

KEY FILES AND LOCATIONS
-----------------------
  C:\NOS\SHELL\SHELL.EXE     NOS-SHELL (starts automatically)
  C:\NOS\SHELL\LAUNCHER.CFG  F9 launcher entries
  C:\NOS\SYSTEM\             System utilities
  C:\NOS\NPKG\INSTALLED.DB   Installed package registry
  C:\APPS\                   Productivity applications
  C:\GAMES\                  Games
  C:\USER\                   Your personal files
  C:\TEMP\                   Temporary files

GETTING HELP
------------
  F1 in NOS-SHELL     Open documentation viewer
  NPKG /?             Package manager help
  NNET /?             Networking help
  NBRIDGE /?          Host bridge help
  NOSPLAY /?          Game launcher help
